source_revision.identity: content digests below are authoritative because Stage 0.4 is not committed at git_head

benchmark_generation.effective_unit_of_analysis: program template or construct family; individual generated references are descriptive repetitions, not independent observations

known_limitations: generated Stage 0.4 corpus has one program template and is not independent external evidence
static binding completeness does not prove runtime target soundness
strong structural Python binder tied Meldra at 1920 of 1920 generated references
reference evaluator executes frozen frontend declarations rather than an independently implemented CoreIR evaluator
benchmark generator constructs both fixture source and expected target coordinates
negative cases are nine templates repeated forty times
semantic changes are five templates repeated forty times on the same graph shape
no independent human author or reviewer participated
no same-model paired agent experiment was run
no source-preserving Meldra ChangeIR materialization exists
no production runtime incremental compiler package manager or target backend exists

shared_components: benchmark calls the production parser binder checker lowering evaluator and Core change engine
strong Python benchmark calls the production structural Python binder
current sidecar arm calls the production Python analyzer
self_consistency_risks: one generator emits both source text and expected reference manifest coordinates
expected values and effect traces are authored beside generated programs
impact expectations use a graph shape selected by the same generator
frontend execution and CoreIR lowering are not differentially evaluated by independent interpreters
benchmark_production_logic_audit.consequence: Stage 0.4 results are regression evidence only; they are not independent estimates or a Language Alpha gate
benchmark_production_logic_audit.required_mitigation: Stage 0.4E uses preregistered external tasks, separate statistical units, runtime target observation, maximal Python baseline, and differential semantics

pre_stage04e_audit_tests.note: includes five freeze and protocol integrity tests added without changing frozen frontend semantics

regression_policy.objective_defect_fix: requires a failing regression test before the fix
regression_policy.rule_change: requires version bump and a new protocol version
regression_policy.result_retention: pre-fix and post-fix benchmark results remain separate
regression_policy.historical_recalculation: old results may not be silently replaced by a new implementation
regression_policy.allowed_stage04e_changes: new harnesses tests adapters and reports that do not modify frozen frontend semantics
